name: a question first
headline: A new way to *bee*.
say: This is Hypercomb. [pause:1300] A new way to bee. Most of what people make online lives on a platform: behind an account, ranked by a feed, run by someone else's rules. Hypercomb starts from the other end. Your work lives on your own device, and you decide who it reaches. You are free to connect your community directly to the communities you care about most, with no platform in between. Everything you see running here was recorded live. The drawings show how it works, and anything not built yet, we call planned.
